integrity: Theorem is accompanied by its domain, explicit update law, construction, dependency on the Haslegrave–Cannings theorem, and two different exhaustive finite checkers. No independent external audit or publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The all-even existence construction and odd-size exclusion give a sharp iff criterion, not a general count of eight-cycles at every even length. The 288 count at size 12 is an exhaustive finite calculation with supplied source, not an independent third-party certification; selected older articles were only accessible at abstract level.
title: A sharp eight-cycle threshold for a tie-retaining minority hub on wheels
